actions.reason: The K4_C0001/K4_C0004 boundary is the weakest and most conflicting among the decision-relevant neighbors: the union eigengap has candidate_k=1 with a dominant single-cluster resolution (ER:d2497140466c:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:aad94ea7bd), which is merge-compatible and not evidence for preserving two units, and the normalized-cut cost is the highest (≈0.55), reflecting more cross-boundary connectivity. Native-view boundary representation is conflicting, with CT not representing the boundary (negative silhouette, majority negative fraction) while only WXS separates (ER:d2497140466c:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:aad94ea7bd). Set-level membership is also conflicting for both members: K4_C0001 shows CT non-representation with weak/conflicting other views (ER:d2497140466c:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:e5313ac502) and K4_C0004 shows strong WXS but negative RNA/WSI separation (ER:d2497140466c:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:6e0bda1ea1). The two sets share the OXPHOS-down transcriptomic direction (ER:d2497140466c:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:e5313ac502; ER:d2497140466c:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:6e0bda1ea1), so the union is more consistent with a single unit than with two independently retained units.

actions.reason: K4_C0002 has a substantive, interpretable biological identity: coherent OXPHOS/protein-secretion/fatty-acid/mTORC1 transcriptomic phenotype (ER:c5a58e927fd7:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:fc5a03698e) and a VHL/PBRM1-depleted mutation identity (ER:c5a58e927fd7:biological_support:wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:fc5a03698e). Its decision-relevant boundary against the nearest competing set K4_C0003 is strongly represented: independent two-way spectral ARI 0.846 with within-side affinity 0.570 exceeding between-side 0.193, and the union eigengap resolves at candidate_k=2, indicating the union retains a two-way structure aligned with the current boundary rather than collapsing to a single unit (ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:901823f7b2). The K4_C0001_M_K4_C0004 boundary is also moderately represented (ARI 0.648, within 0.416 > between 0.156) (ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:fb19a1c30f). Although native-view membership representation is weak and partially conflicting (ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:fc5a03698e) and site/acquisition factors are associated with membership (ER:c5a58e927fd7:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:fc5a03698e), the strong, coherent biological identity combined with a strongly represented boundary against the only merge-compatible neighbor supports independent retention.

K4_C0003 has a substantive, interpretable biological identity: coherent immune/inflammatory transcriptomic phenotype (allograft rejection, IFN-γ/α, IL6/JAK/STAT3; ER:c5a58e927fd7:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:42fb02ccf5) and a BAP1-enriched mutation identity (ER:c5a58e927fd7:biological_support:wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:42fb02ccf5). Its boundary against the nearest competing set K4_C0002 is strongly represented (ARI 0.846, within 0.570 > between 0.193, union candidate_k=2 aligned with the current two-way structure; ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:901823f7b2), and its boundary against K4_C0001_M_K4_C0004 is weak but not merge-mandating (ARI 0.366, within 0.395 > between 0.148; ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:af5083835c). Native-view membership representation is weak and heterogeneous (ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:42fb02ccf5) and site/acquisition factors are associated with membership (ER:c5a58e927fd7:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:42fb02ccf5), but the coherent immune/BAP1 identity together with the strongly represented boundary against its only merge-compatible neighbor supports independent retention.

K4_C0001_M_K4_C0004 has a substantive, interpretable biological identity: coherent suppressed OXPHOS/immune-axis transcriptomic phenotype with activated developmental/signaling programs (ER:c5a58e927fd7:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:2e98e40a49) and a VHL/PBRM1-enriched, BAP1-depleted mutation identity (ER:c5a58e927fd7:biological_support:wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:2e98e40a49). Native-view membership representation is weak and cross-modally heterogeneous (ER:c5a58e927fd7:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:2e98e40a49) and site/acquisition factors are associated with membership (ER:c5a58e927fd7:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:2e98e40a49), but the coherent VHL/PBRM1-enriched identity together with the moderately represented boundary against its nearest neighbor supports independent retention.
